title: NumpadKey - T9 Virtual Keypad for Android 1.0 (HTC Dream / G1)
summary: Pioneering T9-style on-screen virtual keyboard for Android 1.0 on the historic HTC Dream (T-Mobile G1), enabling rapid one-handed touch typing on early small capacitive displays without sliding out the physical keyboard.
highlights: Engineered natively in pure Java for Android 1.0, developed before Google released official system IME / virtual keyboard frameworks in Android 1.5 Cupcake.
Intuitive 3x4 / 4x4 alphanumeric T9 keypad layout with multi-tap cycling, long-press accent/symbol popups, and dedicated punctuation.
Bypassed the need to open the bulky physical slider keyboard on the HTC Dream, enabling seamless one-handed messaging and text entry.
